# Layout

- The CLI lives in `cmd/tool/main.go`; the scratch notes in `notes/local.md` (untracked).
- Branches: `origin/main`, `feature/x`. The site is `example.tools/install.sh`.
- See [the guide](https://example.invalid/guide.md) and `$HOME/x/*.md` and `<repo>/README.md`.

```
cat docs/missing-in-code.md
```
- Run `/ship` or `/login`; docs live at `.../plans/`.
- The sibling repo's guide is `docs/shared/GUIDE.md`.
